### Issues

**[HIGH] Modern test peer cannot negotiate 2026-07-28 as specified; RED/GREEN unattainable**
File: `.scratch/header-parameter-transit/spec.md:138`, `:46`, `:136`, §5 AC01-1
Confidence: HIGH
Issue: T1 pins the modern peer to `ServerOptions{SupportedProtocolVersions: ["2026-07-28"]}` via the existing harnesses, but both build `NewStreamableHTTPHandler(…, nil)` → `Stateless=false` (dedicated_test.go:47; serve_upstream_restart_test.go:32). go-sdk v1.8.0 `StreamableServerTransport.SupportsProtocolVersion` (streamable.go:871-876) is false for ≥2026-07-28 unless stateless; `Server.Connect` filters the advertised list (server.go:1459), `discover` serves it (server.go:926-929), so the client finds no mutually supported ≥2026-07-28 (client.go:428-443) and falls back to legacy `initialize` (client.go:376-381). The "modern" peer negotiates 2025-11-25: post-fix the header call hits the legacy gate → `parameter_header_unsupported` instead of success; AC01-1..4/AC02-1..4/AC03-1 can never go GREEN. Repo counter-evidence: only `StreamableHTTPOptions{Stateless: true}` tests negotiate 2026-07-28 (runtime_test.go:138,149).
Fix: amend T1 scope + AC01-1/`:46` wording: modern peer = stateless handler (`&mcp.StreamableHTTPOptions{Stateless: true}`) built in the new test file (newPeer hardcodes a stateful handler; dedicated_test.go is out of envelope), keeping the `ServerOptions` pin; legacy peer unchanged.

**[LOW] Anchor residue (F5 partial)** — `spec.md:42` area: `Server.Stateless` is config.go:**41** (predicate :48-53); `spec.md:48`: schema canonicalization is core.go:**245-262** (:269-298 is Dispatch); `spec.md:51`: CallTool is runtime.go:**184-233** (cited :178-234). Claims true; repoint anchors. Confidence: HIGH.

**[LOW] Focused `-run` patterns omit two named oracles** — `spec.md:143,157`: `TestStatefulHeaderParameterToolSucceeds` (AC03-1) and `TestLegacyProtocolHeaderParameterToolFailsWithNamedCode` (AC03-2) match no alternation; only full-suite commands 3/4 run them. Extend patterns (e.g. `HeaderParameter`). Confidence: HIGH.

**[LOW] `:155-260` over-broad** — `spec.md:52` includes `TestUpstreamEphemeralHandshakeLog` (:220-260), not a restart test (also body-only, so harmless). Cite :155-218. Confidence: HIGH.
